athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ، وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا، وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
athkar.english_text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
athkar.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
athkar.reference_ar: البقرة 255 — رواه أبو داود وصححه الألباني
athkar.reference_en: Qur'an 2:255 (Ayat al-Kursi); Abu Dawud, graded sahih

athkar.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ — مع قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ وقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
athkar.english_text: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge; He neither begets nor is born; and there is none comparable to Him — together with Surah al-Falaq and Surah an-Nas.
athkar.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad... (with al-Falaq and an-Nas)
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي وصححه الألباني
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidhi, graded sahih

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduk...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه البخاري — سيد الاستغفار
athkar.reference_en: Al-Bukhari - the master of seeking forgiveness

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya wa bika namut, wa ilaykan-nushur
athkar.reference_ar: رواه الترمذي
athkar.reference_en: At-Tirmidhi

athkar.arabic_text: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
athkar.english_text: We have entered the morning and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah; there is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. His is the kingdom and His is the praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it.
athkar.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbahal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه مسلم
athkar.reference_en: Muslim

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, grant my body health; O Allah, grant my hearing health; O Allah, grant my sight health; there is no deity except You.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini fi sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي
athkar.english_text: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter; O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religion, my worldly life, my family and my wealth.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alukal-'afwa wal-'afiyata fid-dunya wal-akhirah...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه ابن ماجه وأبو داود
athkar.reference_en: Ibn Majah and Abu Dawud

athkar.arabic_text: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
athkar.english_text: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all existence, by Your mercy I seek help; set right all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.
athkar.transliteration: Ya Hayyu ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astaghith, aslih li sha'ni kullahu...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه الحاكم والبيهقي وصححه الألباني
athkar.reference_en: Al-Hakim and al-Bayhaqi, graded sahih

athkar.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
athkar.english_text: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
athkar.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي — من قالها ثلاثًا لم يضره شيء
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidhi - whoever says it three times, nothing will harm him

athkar.arabic_text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
athkar.english_text: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
athkar.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin salla Allahu alayhi wa sallama Nabiyya
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود — كان حقًا على الله أن يرضيه
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud - it becomes Allah's own promise to please him

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ، وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا، وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
athkar.english_text: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth.
athkar.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyum, la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm...
athkar.reference_ar: البقرة 255 — من قالها حين يمسي لم تقترب منه الجن حتى يصبح
athkar.reference_en: Qur'an 2:255 (Ayat al-Kursi); whoever recites it at evening is protected until morning

athkar.arabic_text: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ — مع قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ وقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
athkar.english_text: Say: He is Allah, the One; Allah, the Eternal Refuge; He neither begets nor is born; and there is none comparable to Him — together with Surah al-Falaq and Surah an-Nas.
athkar.transliteration: Qul huwallahu ahad... (with al-Falaq and an-Nas)
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي — تكفيك من كل شيء
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidhi - they will suffice you against everything

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya wa bika namut, wa ilaykal-masir
athkar.reference_ar: رواه الترمذي
athkar.reference_en: At-Tirmidhi

athkar.arabic_text: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
athkar.english_text: We have entered the evening and the whole kingdom belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah; there is no deity except Allah alone, without partner. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it.
athkar.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsal-mulku lillah, wal-hamdu lillah...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه مسلم
athkar.reference_en: Muslim

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no deity except You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep Your covenant and promise as much as I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done; I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana abduk...
athkar.reference_ar: رواه البخاري — من قالها موقنًا بها حين يمسي فمات من ليلته دخل الجنة
athkar.reference_en: Al-Bukhari - whoever says it with certainty at evening and dies that night enters Paradise

athkar.arabic_text: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
athkar.english_text: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
athkar.transliteration: A'udhu bi-kalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq
athkar.reference_ar: رواه مسلم — لم يضره شيء حتى يصبح
athkar.reference_en: Muslim - nothing will harm him until morning

athkar.arabic_text: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
athkar.english_text: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing on earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
athkar.transliteration: Bismillahil-ladhi la yadurru ma'as-mihi shay'un fil-ardi wa la fis-sama'i wa huwas-Sami'ul-'Alim
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود والترمذي
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud and at-Tirmidhi

athkar.arabic_text: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
athkar.english_text: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
athkar.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bil-Islami dina, wa bi-Muhammadin salla Allahu alayhi wa sallama Nabiyya
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود — كان حقًا على الله أن يرضيه
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud - it becomes Allah's own promise to please him

athkar.arabic_text: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
athkar.english_text: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no deity except Him. In Him I have placed my trust, and He is the Lord of the Mighty Throne.
athkar.transliteration: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Huwa, alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Azim
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود — من قالها سبعًا كفاه الله ما أهمه
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud - whoever says it seven times, Allah suffices him in what worries him

athkar.arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
athkar.english_text: O Allah, grant my body health; O Allah, grant my hearing health; O Allah, grant my sight health; there is no deity except You.
athkar.transliteration: Allahumma afini fi badani, Allahumma afini sam'i, Allahumma afini fi basari, la ilaha illa ant
athkar.reference_ar: رواه أبو داود
athkar.reference_en: Abu Dawud
